details:
vrchat crashes abruptly on a radeon hd 5770 video card, it can crash when entering a certain card or when loading an avatar, but even if I can enter the world, then after an arbitrary time, it can crash, while all avatars on the card are turned off.

the crash occurs abruptly, just a black screen and vrchat does not respond, but there are very rare crashes with a crash log in which the last two entries are always

D3D11: Failed to create RenderTexture (1280 x 720 fmt 27 aa1), error 0x887a0005

D3D11: Failed to create RenderTexture (1280 x 720 fmt 19aa 1), error 0x887a0005

The start of the crashes started about 4-6 months ago, everything worked fine before.

At the same time, everything works fine on the built-in video core in the intel core i5-8400 UHG 630 processor, but with friezes for obvious reasons.

UDP: I just started grumbling in windowed mode and there is a new error in the crash log

The shader program is not supported, but since rendering with job support is enabled, the shader program cannot be deleted

in Google, I was able to find a possible solution, but in the Vrchat_Data folder, find the boot.config file and change the value of the gfx-enable-gfx-jobs parameter to 0, but for natural reasons, EAC does not let into the game.

UDP2: good news, probably

maybe the problem was solved after adding two startup arguments

-disable-gpu-skinning -force-d3d11-singlethreaded

at least in situations where I have definitely crashed, does not crash, I will watch.
title: RX 5770 dx11 crash error 0x887a0005
